name: Arima Bluette
original_name: 有馬 ブリュエット
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c110156]Shinoa's[/url] mother. She is half-French. 
She treats her best friend's children — Kokona's son Shouta and daughter Eimi — like her own.

She came to Japan as a student and has lived there ever since, so she is highly fluent in Japanese.  

Since their school days, she has been close friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c169460]Kokona[/url]. She has adored [url=https://vndb.org/c169626]Shouta[/url], Kokona’s son, ever since he was a little boy. Knowing how Shinoa feels about him, she strongly hopes the two will get married.  

However, because of the upcoming trip, she ends up having to desperately go on a diet. By asking Shouta for help with it, their relationship begins to change dramatically in many ways.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1368656/]Getchu[/url]]
